about_the_game:
You are trapped in a serial killer's house.At the beginning of the game, you wake up locked in a cell.You can use a fake wooden key to open the cell.After escaping from the cell, you need to open the wardrobes and lockers.There you can find keys, tools, explosives, guns, etc.

The enemy locks doors with padlocks and creates barricades near doors.You need to unlock or destroy the door using things you find from lockers and wardrobes.After unlocking or destroying the door, you can escape from the enemy.

Sometimes the enemy creates barricades near the outside gate and locks the gate with padlocks.You can escape through the kitchen door, front door, front gate, and kitchen gate depending upon the mission.Sometimes you can find car keys to escape from the enemy.During the gameplay the enemy tries to kill you. Find a hiding place when the enemy tries to attack.

You can find hiding places on the first floor and ground floor.You can also use the attic as a hiding place when the enemy is following you.Sometimes the enemy uses a cage to trap the player. Find a cutting player to disable the cage.There are also cages to trap the enemy.You must find all parts of the cage before trapping the enemy.After trapping the enemy, use a phone to call the cops.

You can kill the enemy using grenades, mines, guns, spikes, etc.Every time you will get a different mission when you press the play button each time.You can use bombs, explosives, and a car to escape from the slaughterhouse.There are three different levels of difficulty.Easy,medium,hard.

name: Cryptic Valley

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 and above 64-bits
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-530,AMD Ryzen 5 series
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 2GB VRAM, NVidia GTX 970, AMD RX 470
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 6 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 and above 64-bits
  • Processor: Intel Core i7,AMD Ryzen 7
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 4GB VRAM, NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 / AMD Radeon RX 6700 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 6 GB available space
